name: ti64_anodize
note: Type-II/III style Ti anodize as a single TiO2 thin film (IOR 2.4) on Ti-6Al-4V (Blender 4.2 Principled thin film over the F82 conductor). Interference colour depends on oxide thickness; nominal voltages follow common shop colour charts, thicknesses were picked from a normal-incidence thin-film model so the colour matches the chart (~2.2-2.5 nm/V above ~30 V, sub-linear below). appearance_assumed, not a measured coating. Handle/ring/pad/spine anodized; bevel, edge apex and serrations stay raw bright Ti (they are ground after anodizing on real knives). Signature (maker's mark) is still mixed over every slot last.

dark_smoke.note: dark grey PVD/DLC-like (not anodize: Ti anodize cannot make black)
dark_smoke.signature_contrast: low (black on near-black; reads by roughness only)
